record.question: According to Section 8 of BSA ,2023, when there are reasonable grounds to believe that several persons have conspired to commit an offence, which of the following is relevant against each conspirator?
options: Only acts done after the conspiracy is proved in court
Anything said, done, or written by any conspirator in reference to their common intention while the conspiracy existed
Only confessions made before a Magistrate
